pr_title: Fix actors not being visible when created within sight range of an enemy
pr_body:
Since bbf5970bc16a41ac5f7a7324c99dd0c3a917418d we only update frozen actor state on demand rather than every tick. However when the actor was initially created we were failing to set the initial visibility state if the frozen actor was invisible.

With this fix, we now set the visibility states on creation correctly. This fixes an issue where enemy actors created within line of sight would not appear.

----

Fixes #20179

Test scenarios:

- When a building is created within line of sight, ensure it appears. Then move out of sight, and the frozen building appears.
- When a building is created out of line of sight, nothing is seen. Then move into line of sight and the building appears. Then move out of sight, and the frozen building appears.
- When using Explored Map = true, frozen buildings can be seen on the map when the game starts and can be targeted. e.g. oil derricks.
- When frozen buildings are visible and you hover over one, they do not have healthbars and do have tooltips.
pr_comments:
Confirmed fixed.

Edit: I have health bars only on damage so didn't notice the issue Pun posted below.

Great catch, have pushed an update and added an extra testcase to the original post. One key problem was disabling the healthbars but leaving tooltips visible. With some luck the test scenarios are now comprehensive as the frozen logic is quite fiddly indeed.

issue_context.title: Buildings created in view of enemy are invisible to them
issue_context.body:
With fog enabled, if you place a building within vision range of an enemy, it is invisible to said enemy, unless they move out of vision range and back into it.

Seems to be caused by [PR 20156](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/pull/20156).

Assuming it just needs to trigger an update immediately if a FrozenUnderFog actor is created in view of the enemy.

review_comments: Why do we have to set this manually? Shouldn't this be covered by https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/blob/aa14c9c570a8ac3856dceca94025b7a48bce0a95/OpenRA.Game/Traits/Player/FrozenActorLayer.cs#L127?

That line will set Hidden to `true` during the setup. So we need to manually change it to false.

This is required for tooltips to be visible on the frozen actor. If you comment out that line you will find tooltips no longer appear for the frozen actor.

Ah I see so this is for `startsRevealed`. (Because if `state.IsVisible` is `true` `Hidden` shouldn't be set to `true` right?)
Another comment here might be good, or we change it to `state.FrozenActor.Hidden = !startsRevealed;` which should also make things clearer.

Added a comment to it.

I found the following behaviour works with `state.FrozenActor.Hidden = false;` but breaks with `state.FrozenActor.Hidden = !startsRevealed;`

- A building is created in line of sight
- You leave line of sight
- Hovering the frozen building produces a tooltip.

The tooltip will be missing with the suggested change.

I too don't find it intuitive, so at this point I'm just aiming for getting the testcases to all pass.
Hm ok, that actually sounds like something else is bogus here. We don't need to fix it in this PR Imho.
